item.title: 【HD Live Performances】WEB-DL - Night Tapes - Unplugged Session at Von Krahl in Tallinn (2026-01-31) 1080p
item.description:
Fresh off touring North America, Europe and UK with „portals//polarities“, which won the Alternative Album of the Year award at the Estonian Music Awards, Night Tapes gave a one-time-only acoustic set at Von Krahl.

It’s a live performance woven with a candid interview, where the listener can go inside the music and learn all about the band – from humble beginnings as roommates in a tiny London flat and finding their feet in the music industry, to high praise from fans and critics alike, landing on the cover of NME Magazine and selling out venues all across the world. The band was interviewed by music journalist Aleksander Algo.

Among the songs performed were „every day is a game“, „babygirl (like no1 else)“, „Forever“, and „drifting“.

(from https://kultuur.delfi.ee/artikkel/1...ve-watch-night-tapes-special-acoustic-concert)
